details: Every coordinate in a realizable star is distinguished by two concepts, so it lies in the effective range.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Lemma `lem:elementary-parameter-hierarchy`.
name: Effective Range / Star Number
witness_verification: For the family #classes/halfintervals with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n-1$ and $2$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
